g-from-f.alt: Top: the graph of f on [0, 8]: a line from (0, 2) to (2, 0), a semicircle of radius 2 below the axis from x = 2 to 6, and a line from (6, 0) to (8, 2); the triangles have area 2 each and the half-disc area 2 pi. Bottom: g(x), the integral of f from 0 to x, rises to a relative maximum of 2 at x = 2, falls to a relative minimum of 2 - 2 pi at x = 6, and has an inflection point at x = 4, where f changes from decreasing to increasing.
